tagline.en_US: Self-hosted event photo gallery for guests, with moderation, QR-code sharing, and local SQLite storage.

description.en_US: Guestroll is a self-hosted event photo gallery designed for gathering photos from attendees. Guests scan a QR code to open the camera directly in their mobile browser and submit photos without installing an app or creating an account. Hosts can manage multiple events, moderate submissions, showcase a live photo wall on screens, and export entire albums as ZIP archives.
